summary_statement: The sad-bias fix is correct and working perfectly (sad 90%→15%, no under-detection). However, validation revealed a separate model-level bias toward happy predictions (70%) that is unrelated to the fix. This is not a regression from the fix but rather a pre-existing model characteristic that was masked by the sad-bias post-processing. Deployment is blocked by this happy over-representation. Recommend validating with real user audio to determine if this is a production issue or a limitation of synthetic test data.
deployment_condition: Safe to deploy ONLY after confirming happy bias is not present in real user audio OR implementing mitigation (model retraining, alternative model, or confidence calibration)
